newsitem.title: GREECE: ABN-AMRO'S VASILOGLOU GOES TO NATL MORTGAGE MUTUAL FUNDS SA.
newsitem.headline: ABN-AMRO'S VASILOGLOU GOES TO NATL MORTGAGE MUTUAL FUNDS SA.

text.p: Marilena Vasiloglou, general manager at ABN AMRO Mutual Funds SA, will join the National Mortgage Mutual Funds SA, a subsidiary of the state National Mortgage Bank, from February 1.

Vasiloglou will be the new general manager at National Mortgage Mutual Funds SA replacing Panayiotis Iatrou who takes over at the helm of Diethniki Mutual Funds SA, a subsidiary of the state National Bank of Greece .

Vasiloglou, 36, holds a Ph.D in operations research from the University of Manchester and headed the investment banking department of ABN-AMRO Bank in Greece before joining the ABN-AMRO Mutual Funds in 1995. She has also worked at the state Commercial Bank of Greece . --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
